error_convention: Absolute occupation probability P(s0=+1); binary-mean error is twice this quantity.
limitations: A retained feasible model gives a numerical upper on its stated finite-menu error, not an all-protocol upper.
Failed local fits and positive local residuals are not lower bounds or global minimax certificates.
Theoretical rival classes include masses beyond the finite numerical search box.
The exact all-parameter three-state construction is proved separately; numerical examples alone do not establish it.
Optional optimizer refits are exploratory; routine replay validates retained models without refitting.
preparation: The target and each comparator start in their own zero-field equilibrium, with observed sector masses1/2.
scope: Bounded numerical upper/falsification diagnostics; no global fit or numerical lower certificate.

summary.scope: Achievable numerical errors of retained shared models on the stated finite menus; no minimax lower bound or all-protocol approximation follows.
